method: Bounded author-side package-only reconciliation cross-check; not blind or independent acceptance

answers.question: What is canonical?
answers.answer: Graph/document, defaults, Node state, definitions and application History remain product-owned. Host runtime values separate.

answers.question: Which reference contracts are normative?
answers.answer: 13 and exhaustive field ledger classify exact identity, normative renameable shape and qualification-only bounds. No copying reference implementation.

answers.question: What does S01 save?
answers.answer: grape.document 1.0 single-Graph envelope; product kind exact refs, ACK capture baseline and new load lifetime; separate export/download.

answers.question: How do ordinary Panels compose?
answers.answer: IH002 shared public PanelWorkspace registration/lifetime/routing/restore contract; no private workspace or central kind switch.

answers.question: How does nested Inspector read/write?
answers.answer: The same ScopedParameterTarget capture/project/commit lease; stale path/type/lifetime fences. Renderer does not traverse resources.

answers.question: How does new Node/Panel language text register?
answers.answer: Feature-owned exact TextRefs and locale contributions; builtin same path; shell common separate; deterministic fallback.

answers.question: Does locale change the document?
answers.answer: No; application preference, projection/search caches only; enum values and user-authored text stay unchanged.

answers.question: Are uncommon seams closed unions?
answers.answer: No: registered GraphKind/StageKind, typed capability directory, GLSL stage artifacts. Support and authority still checked.

answers.question: Can another language replace GLSL?
answers.answer: Not by this handoff. The qualified seam remains GLSL; no language-neutral IR claim.

answers.question: How are boundaries enforced?
answers.answer: Production owner/public-export/rights manifest and changed-file checks, plus behavioral/semantic review; historical matrix not production permission.

answers.question: Where is current implementation progress?
